entities.name: Zygmunt Miłkowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zygmunt Miłkowski, pseudonym Teodor Tomasz Jeż was a Polish romantic writer and politician who struggled for independence of Poland as leader of Polish Union. He became a member of the Serbian Learned Society in 1869, the society which preceded the Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts.
